items.title: iShares Biotechnology ETF (IBB) Adds Gilead and Amgen on Nov. 9
items.summary: The $11.34 billion fund bought $230.1 million of stock on Monday, Nov. 9, lifting 231 positions and trimming none.

items.title: Bayer Wins FDA Approval for Sunharbo for Secondary Stroke Risk Reduction
items.summary: Bayer gains FDA approval for Sunharbo, the first Factor XIa inhibitor approved worldwide, opening new growth opportunities in stroke prevention.

items.title: Amgen vs. Regeneron: Higher Dividends Now or Bigger Growth Later?
items.summary: One biotech pays retirees a bigger check today, while the other carries no net debt and is growing far faster. We put Amgen and Regeneron side by side on income, valuation, and growth to see which one earns a spot in a retirement account.

items.title: 3 Biotech Stocks That Actually Pay Dividends and Keep Raising Them
items.summary: Biotech usually torches cash and dilutes shareholders to fund the next trial. Three drugmakers flip that script, and the one with the smallest yield may be hiding the sturdiest payout of all. Coverage, not yield, tells the real story.

items.title: Adaptive Biotechnologies Corporation (ADPT) Hits Fresh High: Is There Still Room to Run?
items.summary: Adaptive Biotechnologies (ADPT) is at a 52-week high, but can investors hope for more gains in the future? We take a look at the company's fundamentals for clues.

items.title: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) Extends BARDA Deal As Libtayo Long Term Data Holds Up
items.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (NasdaqGS:REGN) reported new long-term Phase 3 data for Libtayo in high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. The trial readout highlighted sustained disease-free and overall survival outcomes in patients treated with Libtayo adjuvant therapy despite high crossover rates.
